title: Sceptical

inlines.v: SCEP'TICAL, adjective 1. Doubting; hesitating to admit the certainty of doctrines or principles; doubting of every thing. 2. Doubting or denying the truth of revelation. The sceptical system subverts the whole foundation of morals.
